In square units rounded to the nearest integer, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
In this case, the area of a right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

Notice that relative to the given angle $∠B,$ we have the length of the opposite side $\overset{―}{AC}$ and need to determine the length of the adjacent side $\overset{―}{BC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $BC:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠B) & =\frac{AC}{BC} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡({70}^{∘}) & =\frac{6}{BC} \\ BC\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({70}^{∘}) & =6 \\ BC & =\frac{6}{\operatorname{tan}⁡({70}^{∘})} \\ BC & =2.183…\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 6\cdot (2.183…) \\  & =6.551… \\  & ≈7,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.
